newsitem.title: POLAND: Tender for North-South Polish motorway seen in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Tender for North-South Polish motorway seen in Q4.

text.p: Poland should open by the end of 1997 a tender for the construction of a motorway linking northwestern port city of Szczecin with its border with the Czech republic, the transport minister said on Thursday.

"We expect that by late this year, in the fourth quarter we will be ready to announce a tender for the A3 (motorway)," Boguslaw Liberadzki told a news conference during an automotive fair in the western Polish city of Poznan.
Liberadzki said the motorway would be an alternative to a transit route through Germany from Scandinavia to the south of Europe.
The tender would be a part of Poland's $8 billion plan to build a network of 2,500 km of toll motorways.
